summary: the reproduce command embedded the absolute package path, so two runs over the same package produced different report bytes
root_cause: The field was written to be copy-pasteable, and the shortest way to make a command runnable is to put the real path in it. Determinism was treated as a property of the verdict rather than of the whole report.
detection: tests/test_compare_sut_results compares two runs over one corpus and reported all seven cases diverging, even though both sides were the same implementation.
fix: reproduce carries the placeholder <package>: copy-pasteable and constant. The rule now stated in uibc_core/explain.py: the report must be byte-identical across runs of the same package.
lesson: Determinism is a property of the document, not of the verdict. Any field derived from the caller's environment - absolute paths, hostnames, timestamps, locales - makes two honest runs incomparable, and the comparison suite will report it as a disagreement between implementations.
